a.xlink:title: Leaves the lazy state if this connectivity is still in it.
Adds the entity with localId() target_local_id to the connectivity of source_item.
Removes the entity with localId() target_local_id from the connectivity of source_item.
Removes all entities connected to source_item.
Allocates and positions entities connected to source_item.
Replaces the entity at index index of source_item with the entity with localId() target_local_id.
Replaces the entities of source_item with the entities with localId() target_local_ids.
Sizes the storage for a bulk fill and hands out the arrays to write.
Replaces the whole connectivity with one the caller already knows.
Fills a connectivity whose blocks are given in source-item order.
Fills the reverse of a connectivity given in source-item order.
Same as addCells(), filling the family arrays in bulk.
Adds cells to the current mesh.
Sets the cells of every face at once.
